blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) of the House of Representatives on Thursday approved an additional P16 billion to the Department of Agriculture budget in amendments for next year. The move aims to further support farmers, fisherfolk, and the agriculture sector and strengthen programs to prepare them for the looming super El Niño. Under the P7.2-trillion National Expenditure Program (NEP) for 2027, the budget allocated to DA was around P198.45 billion. The subcommittee, composed of select lawmakers from major political parties and the minority bloc, began deliberations on the proposed amendments to the budget for next year. READ: […]...
